method: python/identity_review_vessel.py: FOV-cropped green high-pass thumbnails, 64-px screen (20 candidates per image, plain and mirrored) then 128-px rescoring, against all 42,055 round-3/round-4 training and validation images (APTOS, EyeQ, IDRiD, DeepDRiD, DDR, Messidor-2, ODIR). Positive control: recovers every ODIR/DDR copy present in the export.
visual_review: Top 12 distinct test images (corr128 0.54-0.66) viewed side by side with their best match: all clearly different retinas (different disc position, vessel tree, lesions); similarity driven by illumination crescents. Copies in the ODIR control mostly scored >= 0.8.
limitation: No exact-byte hash comparison against raw source files; copies with heavy crop/rotation could be missed. Clusters are file-name prefixes (presumed patient/exam), not documented patient IDs.
